objectKeys: Sort by Unicode scalar code point; reject duplicate object properties.
strings: Standard JSON quotation and control escapes; lowercase hex in Unicode control escapes; no slash or non-ASCII escaping; reject unpaired surrogates.
numbers: Parse exact decimal values. Emit plain decimal without exponent; strip trailing fractional zeros; normalize all zero including -0 to 0. No IEEE754 rounding, nonfinite values or leading plus sign.
scope: Canonical semantic hashes only; bound original evidence and asset bytes retain independent raw SHA256.
